title: Present Continuous Consolidation
goal: Consolidate estar + gerundio (-ando, -iendo, irregulars) and present tense contrast.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: Review -ando and -iendo formations for all regular verb types.
Consolidate irregular forms: leyendo, durmiendo, yendo, diciendo.
Confidently contrast actions in progress with daily habits.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can talk about actions happening right now using the present continuous with ease.
